scope: Construction of two explicitly selected buried reinforced-concrete clean-water reservoirs WR-RC-BURIED-2X1000-CW, total capacity 2000 m3, each 1000 m3, with 420 m PVC waterstop, 64 m inlet pipe and 64 m outlet pipe. Direct concrete, reinforcement, formwork, waterproofing, potable-water coating, pipework, fittings, disinfection, labor, mechanisms, testing and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved clean-water reservoir structural and hydraulic design, concrete and reinforcement schedules, waterproofing details, piping-valve schedule, geotechnical report, disinfection and testing program, suppliers and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: steel tank or silo scope inferred from storage volume
concrete, reinforcement, waterproofing, pipework, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from reservoir capacity
automatic excavation shoring, groundwater dewatering or road reinstatement
universal retained spare or supplier-roll length
water intake, treatment plant, pumping station, distribution network, tower, sewer or invented price
